240-574-2079-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.
240-574-2079-5470.notes: Depending on how many counters this combo puts on Vish Kal, you can activate its last ability to kill some number of creatures.

1981-2415-5686-6720.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5686-6720.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2292-2738-4871-6026.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Field of Souls, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2723-4245.description:
Deal damage to Vrondiss.
Vrondiss and Blazing Sunsteel trigger.
Resolve the Vrondiss trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blazing Sunsteel trigger, dealing damage to Vrondiss.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1753-2446-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1753-2446-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Living Hive, triggering Breath of Fury and Living Hive.
Resolve the Living Hive trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1594-3532-5078-5957.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Kianne triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

924-4149-4460-4599-4871.easyPrerequisites: Gravespawn Sovereign is untapped or you control another untapped Zombie.
924-4149-4460-4599-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional creatures.
924-4149-4460-4599-4871.description:
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 two additional times.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Ghoul.
When Phyrexian Ghoul dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating eight 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Phyrexian Ghoul from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When Ghoulcaller Gisa dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller Gisa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
924-4149-4460-4599-4871.notes: If Phyrexian Ghoul starts with a power of 4 or greater, you can reduce the number of additional creatures you control. It must get to 8 or higher power before sacrificing it to Gisa.

1116-6798-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
1116-6798-7084.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Sek'Kuar and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

465-4605-5231-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Wormfang Drake and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Wormfang Drake.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
465-4605-5231-7260.notes: You can either cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand or for the harmonize cost, adjusting mana requirements accordingly.

1402-3593-4359-5330.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Diamond Lion from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Diamond Lion by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Garna.
Resolve the Garna ability from step 3, returning all creature cards that were put in your graveyard this turn to your hand.
Repeat.

3165-3446-3532-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3165-3446-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Managorger Hydra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

5671-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, The Necrobloom triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Ley Weaver with "Elf" chosen

907-1399-1606-7040.description:
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Selesnya Sanctuary.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

620-3532-5078-6709.easyPrerequisites:
There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
620-3532-5078-6709.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Yotian Dissident.
Repeat.

2173-2932-5147-5220.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2173-2932-5147-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
2173-2932-5147-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1003-2173-2921-5220.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

339-677-2292-4359.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1580-4871-5147-5921.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

2724-3080-3557-4608.notablePrerequisites:
Brago does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control at least four enchantments.
2724-3080-3557-4608.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Brago, triggering it, blinking Exchange of Words.
Exchange of Words leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering the second ability it gained from Wormfang Manta's textbox as well as its own ability.
Resolve the first Exchange of Words trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second Exchange of Words trigger, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.

92-2063-3392.description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage's second ability by paying {1}{W}{B}, causing each opponent to lose life whenever you gain life this turn.
Activate Mischievous Poltergeist by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 2 until you have 1 life.
Activate Children of Korils by sacrificing it, causing you to gain life equal to the amount of life you've lost this turn.
Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the amount of life you gained.

360-397-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
360-397-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing the Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
When the Citizen enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1778-2538-3676-6193.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Tangleroot triggers, adding {G}.
When Memnite enters the battlefield, Soul of the Harvest triggers.
Holding priority, activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, replacing the next card you draw.
Resolve the Soul of the Harvest trigger, causing you to return Memnite from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1912-3671-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Wily Goblin.
When Wily Goblin enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1006-2178-3523.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
1006-2178-3523.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1580-2034-2060-3602.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {C}{C}.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Bhaal triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler and goading it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

678-2060-4050.description:
Cast Crystalline Crawler by paying {4} in four different colors, causing Crystalline Crawler to enter the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4} in four different colors.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Crystalline Crawler, adding one mana of any color.
When Crystalline Crawler dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Crystalline Crawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

914-2429.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least ten artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2429.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least ten Treasure tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Revel in Riches' second ability triggers, causing you to win the game.

3011-4179.notablePrerequisites:
Heartless Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
Your opponents have a life total of twenty or greater, minus two for each poison counter they have.
Your life total is no greater than nineteen, minus two for each poison counter you have.
3011-4179.description:
Cast Triumph of the Hordes by paying {2}{G}{G}, giving each creature you control +1+1, trample and infect until end of turn.
Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, causing each player to get a number of poison counters equal to half their life total, rounded down.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

38-392-2440-3705.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Squee enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding at least {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1309-1987-2427-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus and Salvager of Secrets, blinking them.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
